bench_setup = function() {
	set.seed(20261117)
	n = 500L
	n_pairs = 200L
	m = c(rep(seq_len(n_pairs), each = 2L), rep(0L, n - 2L * n_pairs))
	m = m[sample.int(n)]
	list(m = as.integer(m), row_weights = rexp(n))
}
stands_in_for: R/EDI/R/globals.R:262 (kk_pair_and_reservoir_bootstrap_weights), called per bootstrap replicate e.g. from R/EDI/R/inference_continuous_KK_ols_one_lik.R:488
notes: Times one replicate's pair/reservoir weight split at n=500 (200 matched pairs, 100 reservoir rows, one rexp weight draw): the vapply/which loop against two rowsum() calls. closed_form tier because a pair mean of two values may differ in the last ulp (mean() vs sum/count). The build_combined_cpoisson_data caching half of the finding is not covered (it needs an edit inside EDI); the candidate call is well under 1 ms, so the harness's block timing applies.
